'''DS-61-4 EPP & ECC Beatdown''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[DS-61-4 (player)|DS-61-4]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/14lite.htm EPP & ECC Beatdown], The Outer Rim (DS-61-4 (player)). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155333/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/14lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DS-61-4 (player)|DS-61-4]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''EPP & ECC Beatdown''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Cantina|Premiere-L-tatooinecantina.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE EPP & ECC Beatdown DS-61-4 LS 2001.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' EPP & ECC Beatdown

== Introduction ==

DS-61-4 posted this Enhanced Premiere / Enhanced Cloud City mains list on The Outer Rim as EPP & ECC Beatdown.
